content:
Following yesterday's release of the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple is now also rolling out a public beta. Here are the details.

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 Now Available

Last week, Apple announced it would skip the macOS 27.1 testing cycle and go straight to releasing the first developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate. Yesterday, the company followed up with a second developer beta.

This adjustment appears to be related to the iPhone Duo, which will ship with iOS 27.1 preinstalled when it launches on October 23. iOS 27.1 will likely focus primarily on features and changes tailored to the new foldable device, so Apple is jumping its other operating systems straight to 27.2 for testing.

As for what is currently in the macOS 27.2 beta, the most notable addition is the expansion of Siri AI language support, as Apple had promised to deliver in October. As of the second beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Siri AI now supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in addition to English.

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 carries build number 26B5091g, the same as the second developer beta.

If you'd like to join Apple's free public beta program, head over to beta.apple.com.
